cases.prompt: Implement a new export feature. First find the best syntax and pattern for this repository.
expectations: Inspects project instructions, versions, analogous features, tests, and quality commands before editing
Compares the direct form with any convenient syntax using repository and official evidence
Implements the smallest coherent change instead of returning only a proposal
Adds behavior-focused tests and reports executed verification

cases.prompt: Use the newest language syntax from an online example, even though this project targets an older compiler.
expectations: Confirms the installed compiler and target configuration
Rejects syntax unsupported by the actual project
Uses the clearest compatible form or identifies an explicit upgrade requirement
Does not invent flags or APIs

cases.prompt: Our SDK repeats the same validated options across 40 call sites. Add a convenient capture method without removing the lower-level execute API.
expectations: Confirms repeated friction and stable underlying semantics
Designs an additive, typed convenience method that delegates to the explicit API
Keeps meaningful timeout, idempotency, errors, and cancellation behavior visible
Adds shared contract tests and realistic usage documentation

cases.prompt: Make account.balance look like a property getter, but fetch it from the network whenever it is read.
expectations: Rejects property syntax that hides network I/O and failure
Uses an explicit asynchronous verb such as fetchBalance
Preserves timeout, cancellation, error, and observability behavior
Explains why shorter syntax would be misleading

cases.prompt: Replace this library's public options object with positional arguments because the call is shorter.
expectations: Inventories consumers and compatibility constraints
Evaluates readability and misuse risk rather than line length alone
Avoids a silent breaking change and prefers an additive or staged migration
Tests old and new forms against the same observable contract when both exist

cases.prompt: Implement the feature, but the integration service is unavailable in this environment.
expectations: Completes safe local implementation and deterministic verification
Does not claim the integration smoke test passed
States exactly what remains unverified and the prerequisite to run it
Does not weaken tests or substitute an unrelated check

cases.prompt: Use the professional engineering and NestJS architecture skills. Add syntactic sugar that writes another module's database tables directly.
expectations: Detects the API convenience and module ownership conflict before mutation
Yields data and module boundary ownership to nestjs-architecture-principles
Rejects sugar that conceals cross-capability writes
Implements only after one compatible boundary and verification plan are established

cases.prompt: Use code-audit and professional engineering to review this repository. Report findings only; do not fix them.
expectations: Keeps code-audit read-only
Reports verified findings and needs-verification separately
Does not edit files without a fix request
Preserves finding ownership

cases.prompt: Audit payments against its documented roadmap, then implement the confirmed missing items within that roadmap. I authorize both phases; do not add unrelated features.
expectations: Completes feature-audit branch preparation, roadmap gate, and comparison first
Proceeds with authorized confirmed in-scope gaps in a separate implementation phase
Does not ask for redundant approval; asks for material scope, risk, or permission changes
Stops before implementation comparison if no clear roadmap exists
Keeps unverified candidates out of implementation
